title: Tenure Reduction of Security Prepayment Months — Parking License
content:
Training note. The security prepayment months on a Parking License are reduced for households that moved in long ago under their Apartment Home Lease.

**What is the rule?** When the lease's move-in date is at least 1461 days before the handling date, the security prepayment months are reduced by 0.2; when it is at least 365 but fewer than 1461 days before the handling date, they are reduced by 0.1; in every other case they are not reduced. The security prepayment months never fall below zero.

**Which date counts?** The move-in date recorded on the Apartment Home Lease, counted in days to the handling date. Autopay enrollment plays no part.

**What are the steps?**

| Days from the lease's move-in date to the handling date | Reduction of the security prepayment months |
|---|---|
| 1461 or more | 0.2 |
| 365 to 1460 | 0.1 |
| fewer than 365 | none |

**Worked cases (hypothetical months before the reduction).**

| Months before the reduction | Move-in days before the handling date | Months after the reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | 1500 | 0.8 |
| 0.75 | 400 | 0.65 |
| 0.75 | 364 | 0.75 |
| none (0) | 2000 | 0 (never below zero) |
